entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return an item. Order number is VF90210. Just need the instructions.
Certainly. I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's a jersey. It's the wrong size. It's just too tight in the shoulders.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I'm looking at the order now and I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered on November 3rd. Since it's within our 90-day return period, that's no problem at all.
Great. So you're sending a label?

Yes, I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Would you like me to process an exchange for a larger size for you right now?
No, just the return label is fine. I'll re-order later if I need to. That's all.
You got it. The label is on its way. Thanks for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
